analysis.summaryJa: このページは時間表現を、完了期限のby、状態・動作が終点まで続くuntil、名前の付いた出来事・期間の内部を示すduring、期間の長さを測るforとして整理する。さらにwithinとthroughoutを対比し、時間線上のどこを見ているかで選ぶ。
grammarPoints: byは一回の行為が期限以前に完了することを示す
untilは状態・動作が終点まで継続することを示す
duringは出来事や暦期間の内部を示す
forは時間量としての長さを示す
withinは時間枠内の完了、throughoutは期間全体の継続を示す
visualEvidence: タイムライン上の締切点へチェック印が置かれbyを示す
開始から終点まで続く帯がuntilを示す
大きな期間枠の中の点がduringを示す
両端を持つ長さの矢印がforを示す
期間内の任意点と全域を塗る図がwithinとthroughoutを対比する
commonTraps: 継続状態にbyを使って意味を変える
duringの後ろに時間量だけを置く
forの後ろに出来事名を置いてduringと混同する
byとwithinの期限範囲の違いを見落とす

questions.prompt: Please approve the final artwork ------- 4:00 p.m. so printing can begin today.

choices.B: until
choices.C: during
choices.D: for

questions.translationJa: 本日印刷を開始できるよう、午後4時までに最終デザインを承認してください。
questions.explanationJa: 承認という完了行為の期限を示すためbyが適切です。

questions.prompt: The replacement parts should arrive ------- the end of the week.

choices.B: by
choices.C: during
choices.D: for

questions.translationJa: 交換部品は週末までに到着する見込みです。
questions.explanationJa: 到着が期限時点以前に完了することを示すbyを使います。

questions.prompt: The customer-service desk remains open ------- 9:00 p.m. on Fridays.

choices.B: during
choices.C: until
choices.D: for

questions.translationJa: 顧客サービス窓口は金曜日は午後9時まで開いています。
questions.explanationJa: 開いている状態が終点まで継続するためuntilです。

questions.prompt: The guests waited in the lobby ------- the shuttle arrived.

choices.B: during
choices.C: for
choices.D: until

choices.C: during
choices.D: for

questions.prompt: The training session will last ------- approximately ninety minutes.

choices.B: for
choices.C: until
choices.D: during

choices.C: during
choices.D: for

questions.prompt: All expense claims must be filed ------- thirty days of the trip.

choices.B: until
choices.C: during
choices.D: for

questions.prompt: The lights stayed on ------- the entire overnight inspection.

choices.B: until
choices.C: for
choices.D: throughout

questions.translationJa: 照明は夜通しの検査全体を通して点灯していました。
questions.explanationJa: 期間の初めから終わりまで全体にわたるためthroughoutです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence requiring completion no later than a deadline.

choices.A: Submit the signed form until noon.
choices.B: Submit the signed form by noon.
choices.C: Submit the signed form during noon.
choices.D: Submit the signed form for noon.

questions.translationJa: 署名済み用紙を正午までに提出してください。
questions.explanationJa: 一回の完了行為の期限はbyで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence predicting arrival before a deadline.

choices.A: The parcel will reach us until Tuesday.
choices.B: The parcel will reach us during Tuesday for a deadline.
choices.C: The parcel will reach us by Tuesday.
choices.D: The parcel will reach us for Tuesday.

questions.translationJa: 荷物は火曜日までに到着します。
questions.explanationJa: reachという到達の完了期限にはby Tuesdayを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing a state continuing to an endpoint.

choices.A: The lounge will remain closed by Monday.
choices.B: The lounge will remain closed during Monday as an endpoint.
choices.C: The lounge will remain closed for Monday only to an endpoint.
choices.D: The lounge will remain closed until Monday.

questions.translationJa: ラウンジは月曜日まで閉鎖されたままです。
questions.explanationJa: remain closedという状態が月曜日まで継続するのでuntilです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing waiting that ends when an event occurs.

choices.A: Please stay here until the manager returns.
choices.B: Please stay here by the manager returns.
choices.C: Please stay here during the manager returns.
choices.D: Please stay here for the manager returns.

questions.translationJa: マネージャーが戻るまでここにいてください。
questions.explanationJa: stayがreturnsの時点まで続くためuntil節を用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence locating an event inside a named meeting.

choices.A: The alarm sounded by the board meeting.
choices.B: The alarm sounded during the board meeting.
choices.C: The alarm sounded until the board meeting.
choices.D: The alarm sounded for the board meeting as duration.

questions.translationJa: 取締役会の最中に警報が鳴りました。
questions.explanationJa: board meetingという出来事の内部で発生したためduringです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence locating an action within a season.

choices.A: Demand usually rises by the holiday season only as completion.
choices.B: Demand usually rises until the holiday season.
choices.C: Demand usually rises for the holiday season as length.
choices.D: Demand usually rises during the holiday season.

questions.translationJa: 需要は通常、休暇シーズン中に増加します。
questions.explanationJa: 特定の季節という期間内を示すduringが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence giving the length of a rental.

choices.A: We rented the equipment by three days.
choices.B: We rented the equipment until three days.
choices.C: We rented the equipment for three days.
choices.D: We rented the equipment during three days.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは機器を3日間借りました。
questions.explanationJa: three daysという期間の長さにはforを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence giving the length of a conversation.

choices.A: The support call lasted for forty minutes.
choices.B: The support call lasted by forty minutes.
choices.C: The support call lasted until forty minutes.
choices.D: The support call lasted during forty minutes.

questions.translationJa: サポート通話は40分間続きました。
questions.explanationJa: 所要時間の長さを表すfor forty minutesが正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence requiring completion inside a seven-day window.

choices.A: Return the device until seven days.
choices.B: Return the device within seven days.
choices.C: Return the device during seven days.
choices.D: Return the device for seven days.

questions.translationJa: 機器は7日以内に返却してください。
questions.explanationJa: 七日間の範囲内のどこかで返却を完了するためwithinです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence covering every part of an event.

choices.A: Security remained present by the ceremony.
choices.B: Security remained present until the ceremony as its whole.
choices.C: Security remained present throughout the ceremony.
choices.D: Security remained present for the ceremony's name only.

questions.translationJa: 式典全体を通して警備員が配置されていました。
questions.explanationJa: 開始から終了まで全体にわたる意味ではthroughoutです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Finish the inventory by Friday."

choices.A: Continue doing the inventory until after Friday.
choices.B: Work on the inventory for exactly one Friday.
choices.C: Complete the inventory no later than Friday.
choices.D: Do the inventory only while Friday is in progress.

questions.translationJa: 遅くとも金曜日までに在庫確認を完了してください。
questions.explanationJa: byは完了の最終期限を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The refund will be issued by tomorrow."

choices.A: The refund process will continue throughout tomorrow necessarily.
choices.B: The refund will remain unissued until after tomorrow.
choices.C: The refund will last for one day.
choices.D: The refund will be issued no later than tomorrow.

questions.translationJa: 返金は遅くとも明日までに行われます。
questions.explanationJa: by tomorrowは明日を含む期限以前の完了です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The desk is staffed until 8:00."

choices.A: Staff remain at the desk up to 8:00.
choices.B: Staff must arrive no later than 8:00 only.
choices.C: Staff work for exactly eight hours.
choices.D: Staff appear sometime during the number eight.

questions.translationJa: スタッフは8時まで窓口にいます。
questions.explanationJa: untilは状態・活動が終点まで続くことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We waited until the rain stopped."

choices.A: We completed waiting before the rain began.
choices.B: Our waiting continued and ended when the rain stopped.
choices.C: We waited for a fixed number of rain hours.
choices.D: We waited at some point during a rain report.

questions.translationJa: 雨が止む時点まで待ち続けました。
questions.explanationJa: until節は継続の終了条件を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The lights failed during the presentation."

choices.A: The lights failed before the presentation deadline.
choices.B: The lights remained failed until the presentation.
choices.C: The lights failed at some point while the presentation was in progress.
choices.D: The lights failed for the exact length of the presentation.

questions.translationJa: 発表が進行中のある時点で照明が故障しました。
questions.explanationJa: duringは名前の付いた出来事の内部を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Sales fell during August."

choices.A: The decline occurred within the month of August.
choices.B: The decline was completed no later than July.
choices.C: Sales stayed low until August began.
choices.D: The decline lasted for exactly August as a number.

questions.translationJa: 売上減少は8月という期間内に起きました。
questions.explanationJa: during Augustは8月の期間内を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "She stayed in Berlin for two weeks."

choices.A: She arrived no later than two weeks.
choices.B: She stayed until the number two weeks.
choices.C: She visited at some point during a named event called two weeks.
choices.D: Her stay in Berlin had a duration of two weeks.

questions.translationJa: ベルリン滞在の長さは2週間でした。
questions.explanationJa: for＋時間量は期間の長さを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The warranty is valid for one year."

choices.A: The warranty must be issued by one year.
choices.B: The warranty's period of validity lasts one year.
choices.C: The warranty continues until a quantity called one year without a start.
choices.D: The warranty applies during one named event.

questions.translationJa: 保証の有効期間は1年間です。
questions.explanationJa: for one yearは有効期間の長さです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Reply within 24 hours."

choices.B: Reply for a total of 24 hours.
choices.C: Reply at some time before the 24-hour period ends.
choices.D: Reply only during an event named 24 hours.

questions.translationJa: 24時間の範囲が終わる前のどこかで返信してください。
questions.explanationJa: withinは時間枠の内部での完了を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The café was busy throughout lunch."

choices.A: The café was busy for the whole lunch period.
choices.B: The café became busy no later than lunch only.
choices.C: The café remained busy until lunch began.
choices.D: The café was busy for an unspecified duration unrelated to lunch.

questions.translationJa: カフェは昼食時間全体を通して混雑していました。
questions.explanationJa: throughoutは期間の全体を覆います。

questions.prompt: Printing begins at five, and the printer needs the approved file first. Send it ------- 4:30.

choices.B: during
choices.C: for
choices.D: by

questions.explanationJa: 更新という完了行為の期限を示すbyが適切です。

questions.prompt: The technician started testing at eight and will continue ------- noon.

choices.B: until
choices.C: during
choices.D: for

questions.translationJa: 技術者は8時に試験を始め、正午まで続けます。
questions.explanationJa: continueという動作が正午を終点として継続するのでuntilです。

questions.prompt: The client has not arrived yet. Keep the reserved room available ------- she calls us.

choices.B: during
choices.C: until
choices.D: for

questions.explanationJa: availableの状態が連絡時点まで続くためuntil節です。

questions.prompt: A fire drill interrupted the interview. The alarm sounded ------- the second question.

choices.B: until
choices.C: for
choices.D: during

questions.translationJa: 避難訓練が面接を中断しました。2問目の最中に警報が鳴りました。
questions.explanationJa: 特定の進行中の部分内で起きたためduringです。

questions.prompt: Many international orders are delayed ------- the year-end holiday period.

choices.B: during
choices.C: until
choices.D: for

questions.translationJa: 年末休暇期間中は多くの国際注文が遅れます。
questions.explanationJa: 名前の付いた期間内の傾向を示すduringが適切です。

questions.prompt: The temporary office will be used ------- four months while the main building is renovated.

choices.B: by
choices.C: until
choices.D: during

questions.translationJa: 本館改装中、仮設事務所を4か月間使用します。
questions.explanationJa: four monthsという長さを示すためforです。

questions.prompt: The package was held at customs ------- nine days before release.

choices.B: until
choices.C: for
choices.D: during

questions.translationJa: 荷物は通関で9日間保留された後に解放されました。
questions.explanationJa: 保留期間の長さを表すfor nine daysが適切です。

questions.prompt: New employees must complete the online course ------- their first month.

choices.B: during
choices.C: for
choices.D: within

questions.translationJa: 新入社員は入社後最初の1か月以内にオンライン講座を修了しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 一か月という枠内で完了するためwithinです。

questions.prompt: The museum kept all exits staffed from opening to closing. Guards were present ------- the day.

choices.B: throughout
choices.C: until
choices.D: for

questions.translationJa: 博物館は開館から閉館まで全出口に人員を置き、一日中警備員がいました。
questions.explanationJa: 一日の初めから終わりまで全体を覆うためthroughoutです。
